name: ADHD & Hygiene
gentle advice: You're not **gross**, you're **overwhelmed**. Hygiene requires task switching, sensory tolerance, and energy, all hard with **ADHD**. You don't need a full shower to care for yourself. Start with a **face wipe**, **fresh clothes**, or **brushing your teeth**. Small steps still count.
stern advice: You can't keep **skipping basic self-care**. Not showering, brushing, or changing clothes isn't just about mood, it affects your **health**. Clean your body. It's **not optional**. No one's coming to rescue you, you have to **show up for yourself**.

name: ADHD & Social Media
gentle advice: Social media gives you **stimulation and connection**, especially when you're lonely or overwhelmed. That's real. But too much of it turns inward and **hurts more than it helps**. Start by **limiting when and how** you use it. Your brain deserves a cleaner input.
stern advice: **Scroll. Spiral. Shame. Repeat.** That's the loop you're stuck in, and it's stealing your time, your self-worth, and your focus. This isn't just a bad habit. It's a system designed to keep you addicted. **Delete the app.** Your brain deserves peace, not performance.

name: Analysis Paralysis
gentle advice: You're not lazy or incapable, your brain is trying to avoid making the **wrong choice** because it cares. **Start smaller than you think**. You don't need to see the whole staircase, just the **next step**. Progress beats perfection.
stern advice: **Pick something.** You're wasting energy trying to get it right. **Action beats perfect** every time. Do it badly, do it now, fix it later. Stop **researching yourself into paralysis**.

name: Anxious
gentle advice: Your brain is trying to **protect you**. That tight chest, spinning mind, and urgency? It's **fear speaking, not facts**. Pause. Breathe into your body. Move slowly. You are **safe right now**, even if your mind says otherwise.
stern advice: You can't keep letting **fear steer the ship**. You've been here before, and you survived. Breathe. Move. **Do the thing**. Let your body prove to your brain that the world won't end.

name: Ashamed
gentle advice: Shame says **you are the problem**, but that's a lie. You're not broken. You're human. Everyone struggles. Everyone slips. Talk to yourself the way you would a friend. You deserve **compassion**, not punishment.
stern advice: **Shame grows in silence**. It's time to drag it into the light. You made a mistake? Own it. Learn. Fix it if you can. But do not let shame stop your life. You're **better than the worst thing** you've done.

name: Bedtime Procrastination
gentle advice: Your day may not feel like it **belongs to you**, so your **night becomes your refuge**. You're not wrong for wanting downtime. Let's build you a routine that feels like a **reward, not a trap**.
stern advice: **Turn it off.** Your 3am scrolling isn't healing you, it's **wrecking your tomorrow**. Your brain is lying to you about needing just a few more minutes.

name: Bills & Money
gentle advice: **Money shame** is real, and ADHD makes managing it harder than it looks. Forgetting, avoiding, or freezing doesn't make you irresponsible. You just need a **system that offloads the remembering**. One bill. One step. That's a win.
stern advice: You're **leaking money** and calling it overwhelm. **Track it. Face it.** You don't get out of financial holes by ignoring them. **Set up autopay**. Cancel what you don't use. Learn what's due and when.
